description: The StreamOne ION v3 reseller API (customers, catalog, orders, subscriptions, carts, reports), plus a local licence book for renewals, margin and cross-distributor true-up.

auth_env_var_specs.name: TD_SYNNEX_ACCESS_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: StreamOne ION OAuth access token (2-hour lifetime). Optional when `auth mint` has stored a token in the credentials file; an env value overrides the stored one.

novel_features.name: Renewal window
novel_features.description: See every subscription renewing or ending in the next N days across the whole book, soonest first, with auto-renew-off ones flagged.

novel_features.name: Book margin
novel_features.description: See monthly cost vs price and margin per customer or per SKU, with negative, zero and below-MSRP rows flagged.

novel_features.name: Licence-position export
novel_features.description: Export your TD SYNNEX licences as normalized, schema-versioned rows (customer, SKU key, seats, monthly cost and price, renewal) for a PSA or a true-up; tenant and domain columns stay blank because ION subscriptions do not carry them.

novel_features.name: Cross-distributor true-up
novel_features.description: Compare seats per customer and SKU across TD SYNNEX and Pax8, Sherweb or PSA export files mapped into the licence-position columns, with unmatched rows listed instead of guessed.

novel_features.name: Subscription change feed
novel_features.description: List seat, renewal, status, tier and friendly-name changes requested through ION orders in a past window, decoded from the order attributes; failed orders are left out and changes made outside ION are not visible.

novel_features.name: Stuck orders
novel_features.description: Find orders still NEW, IN_PROGRESS, CONFIRMED or ON_HOLD past an age threshold, plus recent errors, with a flag for the ones you can still cancel.

novel_features.name: Customer 360
novel_features.description: One view of a customer from the local store: profile, subscriptions with seats and monthly cost and price, open orders and recent changes, plus the cloud-profiles command for live GDAP/MCA status.
